newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up led by foreign funds.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up led by foreign funds.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged slightly higher in trade led by foreign demand for bank stocks, dealers said.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index finished ahead a razor-thin 0.07 percent at 18,268.44 on volume of 1.9 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index climbed 0.10 percent to 1,197.90 in volume of 2.5 billion pesos.
Dealers said foreign demand pushed up Colombian bank stocks traded on Wall Street.
Banco Industrial Colombiano, the financial arm of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, closed at 3,900, up 3.72 percent in Bogota and 3.17 percent in Medellin.
Banco Ganadero, the nation's largest bank in terms of assets, rose 0.76 perecent to 396 on volume of 7.3 million pesos in Bogota and up 0.25 percent to 394 on 45 million pesos traded in Medellin.
Insurance giant Compania Suramericana de Seguros held steady at 28,100 in Bogota and 322 Medellin.
